title: Regulators simplify FAR reporting
full_text:
Regulators simplify FAR reporting
The prudential and corporate regulators have finalised changes that simplify reporting under the Financial Accountability Regime.
Following consultation, the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority and Australian Securities and Investments Commission have removed the requirement to report key functions for the FAR register and the need for maps identifying who reports directly to an accountable person.
“Industry strongly supported these changes, which will reduce unnecessary reporting while maintaining clear accountability,” ASIC commissioner Kate O’Rourke said.
“We are proceeding with the reforms as proposed, delivering on our commitment to simpler regulation and making it easier for industry to meet its obligations.”
The changes will take immediate effect. The accountability obligations of FAR-regulated entities and accountable persons will remain unchanged.
